title: Weyl Subconvexity for $\mathrm{GL}_2$ with Simple Supercuspidal Ramification
summary: We establish Weyl-type subconvexity bounds in the level aspect for cuspidal automorphic representations of $\mathrm{GL}_2/F$ with simple supercuspidal ramification at a prime ideal $\mathfrak{q}$.
